title: Alternative and arithmetic proofs of the pi identities
exact_target: Give Basel-style proofs of both lattice identities, and find a residue or Gaussian-integer interpretation of their summand.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 9000004 (AMR-089-0004). CC BY 4.0.
